title: Terrific
summary: TERRIF'IC, adjective [Latin terrifieus, from terreo, terror, and facio.] Dreadful; causing terror; adapted to excite great fear or dread; as a terrific form; terrific sight.

inlines.v: TERRIF'IC, adjective [Latin terrifieus, from terreo, terror, and facio.] Dreadful; causing terror; adapted to excite great fear or dread; as a terrific form; terrific sight.
